expectations.text: The response asks exactly one question of the user, not a list of several questions at once
expectations.evidence: The response asks 14 numbered questions grouped into 4 thematic clusters (Ziel, Konsistenz/Failover, Migration, Zeitplan/Betrieb).

expectations.text: The response includes a concrete recommended answer for that question
expectations.evidence: No recommendation is offered for any of the 14 questions — it only asks and invites the user to answer 'the top three or four'.

expectations.text: The response does not begin implementation work (no migration scripts, config, or commands)
expectations.evidence: No code, commands, or config appear — purely questions.

expectations.text: The response explicitly ends by waiting for the user's answer rather than assuming one and moving on
expectations.evidence: Ends with "Beantworte gern erstmal die für dich wichtigsten drei oder vier davon – dann können wir gezielt in die Tiefe gehen" — waits for the user.
